title: Physical Education
description: Physical Education (Group III) for ICSE Examination Years 2027 and 2028: growth and fitness theory with six prescribed games.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE Research, Development and Curriculum Division, Physical Education syllabus, Examination Year 2028 (reproduced); cross-checked against the Oswal and Shaalaa 2026-27 listings.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Part 1 Section A is eight compulsory theory topics; Section B is six prescribed games of which candidates answer on two. Part 2 is internal assessment: 50 marks of teacher assessment in two activities and 50 marks of external physical-efficiency and specialisation tests. A 2-hour written paper of 100 raw marks, carried 50/50.

sections.title: Part 1: Theory
sections.description: The eight compulsory theory topics of Section A.

chapters.title: Human Growth and Development
chapters.blurb: Growth against development, the stages from infancy to adulthood and the heredity, environment, gender and nutrition factors.

chapters.title: Physical Education
chapters.blurb: The meaning and objectives of physical education and its physical, psychological, social and emotional outcomes.

chapters.title: Body Types
chapters.blurb: Endomorph, mesomorph and ectomorph: how body build affects training, performance and exercise choice.

chapters.title: Physical Fitness
chapters.blurb: The components of fitness from endurance to accuracy, why each matters and the factors that raise or lower fitness.

chapters.title: Sports Training
chapters.blurb: The principles of training: overload, progression, recovery, specificity, periodisation and how a season is planned.

chapters.title: Safety in Sports
chapters.blurb: Common sports injuries, the first aid they need and the prevention that warm-up, equipment, rules and supervision provide.

chapters.title: Health Education
chapters.blurb: Nutrition and the balanced diet, under- and over-nutrition, dietary modification for sport and practical meal planning.

chapters.title: Careers in Physical Education
chapters.blurb: Coach, physical education teacher, professional sportsperson, sports administration, commentary and officiating.

sections.title: Part 1: Prescribed Games
sections.description: The six prescribed games; candidates answer on two.

chapters.title: Cricket
chapters.blurb: Laws and field dimensions, officials, dismissals, the batting, bowling and fielding skills, terminology and the BCCI and ICC tournaments.

chapters.title: Football
chapters.blurb: The laws of the game, offside and restarts, passing, shooting and goalkeeping skills, terminology and the AIFF, FIFA and IFAB.

chapters.title: Hockey
chapters.blurb: Field and teams, restarts, penalties and cards, the core skills and terminology, and the FIH, IHF and major tournaments.

chapters.title: Basketball
chapters.blurb: Court and equipment, scoring, violations and fouls, dribbling, passing, shooting and defence, plus BFI and FIBA tournaments.

chapters.title: Volleyball
chapters.blurb: Court, net and scoring, rotations, service, setting, attack and block, the libero rule and the VFI and FIVB.

chapters.title: Badminton
chapters.blurb: Court and shuttle, service and scoring rules, lets and continuous play, grips, footwork and strokes, and BAI and BWF.
